verdict.rationale: Yapily's only AI-facing evidence is an MCP/llms.txt connection that lets coding agents search its documentation. There is no evidence that users can operate the banking product itself (payments, account data, consents) with natural-language commands. Docs-search MCP is an adjacent developer aid, not natural-language operation of the product, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Connecting over MCP gives your agent a live, searchable connection to this documentation.
Connect Claude, Cursor, or another AI coding agent directly to these docs via MCP, llms.txt, or Agent Skills.
